# Flowtali

> Flowtali is a professional document tool for freelancers and small teams. Create invoices and branded letterheads with real-time preview, one-click PDF export, and full custom branding.

## What Flowtali does

Flowtali helps freelancers, designers, developers, and small agencies create polished client-facing documents:

- **Invoices**: Line items, taxes (flat or percent), multi-currency, payment links, stamps, PDF export
- **Letterheads**: 5 professional templates (Classic, Modern, Minimal, Bold, Split Panel) with logo, signature, watermark, and accent colors
- **Client management**: Store client details, re-use across documents
- **Team collaboration**: Invite members, assign roles and granular permissions
- **Organization preferences**: Saved invoice profiles, bank accounts, payment links for quick-fill

## Key features

- Real-time preview — see exactly what the client receives before export
- One-click PDF export — pixel-perfect, print-ready output
- Custom branding — logo, signature, accent colors, fonts, watermarks
- Multi-currency — USD, EUR, GBP, NGN, CAD, AUD, and more
- Stamps — add PAID, OVERDUE, DRAFT, or custom text stamps to invoices
- Analytics — revenue, outstanding, collection rate, invoice status breakdown
- Notifications — in-app bell with real-time updates for invoice status changes and team events

## Pricing

- **Starter**: Free — 5 invoices + 3 letterheads/month, basic templates, Flowtali branding
- **Pro**: $10/month (annual) — unlimited documents, all templates, custom branding, no Flowtali branding, priority support
- **Business**: $23/month (annual) — everything in Pro + up to 5 team members, analytics, payment links

## Tech stack

Frontend: Vue 3 + TypeScript, Vite, TailwindCSS, Pinia
Backend: Laravel 11, PHP, MySQL, Sanctum auth
